title: leasekeeper-deterministic-slot-allocator-and-utilization-smoother
author: Aisha Mehta
description:
Summary: Introduce LeaseKeeper (deterministic slot allocator) and a Utilization Smoother to reduce burst-induced jitter and produce stable per-tenant throughput signals for the fleet autoscaler. This change implements a slot lease model with deterministic assignment (no randomized slot shuffles), per-tenant locality buckets to favor cache locality, and a rolling exponential smoother that yields the new smeared_utilization metric for autoscaler / billing consumers.

Motivation: We observed variability in per-tenant utilization signals causing oscillatory autoscaling decisions in Dedicated clusters. The root causes were: nondeterministic slot assignment producing noisy short-lived bursts, and raw instantaneous utilization spikes that propagated into the autoscaler as false positives. The goals are: (1) stabilize utilization time-series, (2) keep short bursts bounded and predictable, (3) prefer locality to reduce KV cache misses.

Design: - LeaseKeeper: central allocator that issues deterministic slot leases for tenants. A slot is owned for a configurable lease_ms; assignments are computed via a deterministic hash+round-robin so that tenants map predictably across restarts (helps testing and debugging). - Locality buckets: tenants are bucketed by node locality tags (region/az/rack) and assigned a locality-weight to prefer slots that keep execution close to cached KV. The allocator falls back to cross-bucket assignment when locality capacity is exhausted. - Utilization Smoother: per-tenant rolling smoother that emits smeared_utilization and peak_tail_percentile metrics. The smoother uses two time constants (fast/slow) and a leakage term so that short spikes decay quickly while sustained load still surfaces. - Autoscaler integration: the fleet autoscaler consumes smeared_utilization instead of raw instantaneous util for scale decisions and exposes an override to fall back to raw util for emergency scaling.

Implementation notes: - New files: src/scheduler/leasekeeper.go, src/scheduler/leasekeeper_test.go, pkg/telemetry/utilization_smoother.go, pkg/telemetry/utilization_smoother_test.go, charts/dedicated/values.yaml (feature toggles), docs/ops/leasekeeper.md, docs/ops/utilization-metrics.md, tests/fixtures/dedicated-locality-buckets.yaml, scripts/measurement/compare-smoothed-vs-raw.py. - LeaseKeeper algorithm: deterministic assignment using tenant_id -> 64-bit hash, mod N_slots_per_node with round-robin offset per-lease-epoch to avoid long-term lockstep. LeaseKeeper maintains a light in-memory lease table and persists short-lived checkpoints to etcd for recovery. - Smoother details: implementation uses a two-pole IIR filter with configurable alpha_fast/alpha_slow and a hysteresis-based peak_tail to preserve tail behavior for SLA evaluation.

Testing: - Unit tests for allocator invariants and smoother edge cases added. - Integration tests simulate tenants with bursty poisson arrivals; validated that autoscaler does not oscillate under controlled synthetic load. - Load experiments on a 48-node dedicated staging cluster showing 22% reduction in autoscaler-triggered scale events and 9% reduction in average cold-KV miss rate for locality-enabled tenants. Test scripts are included under scripts/measurement.

Rollout plan: 1) Feature gate disabled by default. Deploy LeaseKeeper + Smoother as opt-in in staging. 2) Enable for a small set of non-critical tenants in canary mode (1% of production traffic) with observability dashboards. 3) Monitor smeared_utilization vs raw_utilization and autoscaler actions for 72 hours. 4) Gradually expand to 25%/50%/100% after validation.

Backwards compatibility: - Default behavior unchanged unless feature gate is enabled. - Metrics: smeared_utilization is additive to existing metrics; consumers can opt-in.

Metrics / telemetry added: - telemetry.smeared_utilization (gauge per-tenant) - telemetry.leasekeeper_assignments (gauge: slots assigned per-node) - telemetry.slot_lease_ms (histogram) - telemetry.locality_hit_ratio (gauge) - telemetry.autoscaler_input_source (tagged gauge: raw|smoothed) - smoke-test dashboards under console/dedicated/leasekeeper-panel.json

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] Docs: ops runbook + metrics reference - [x] Feature gate + helm values entry - [x] Measurement scripts and staging run notes

Release notes: Introduces LeaseKeeper (deterministic slot allocator) and a Utilization Smoother that provide stable per-tenant utilization signals for the fleet autoscaler. Opt-in behind a feature gate; expected to reduce autoscaler oscillation and improve locality-related cache hit rates.

Related work: Addresses oscillation observed in ENG-2017 and SUP-4521 incident postmortem. Complements prior smoothing work in pr-103845 by adding deterministic slot leases and locality prioritization.
